description: Search Yandex or parse Yandex SERP URLs and collect organic results, ads, knowledge graph and AI answers, inline images and videos, products, local companies, weather, and related searches.

domain.description: Regional Yandex front. yandex.com is the international entry point; Yandex may serve it from its Russia front (reported as servedDomain).
domain.title: Yandex Domain

failIfEmpty.description: Fail the run when no records were produced, instead of finishing with an empty dataset.
failIfEmpty.title: Fail If Empty

fixTypos.description: Let Yandex correct misspelled queries. Turn it off for exact-match searches.
fixTypos.title: Fix Typos

includeAds.description: Include sponsored Yandex Direct rows with their click URL and displayed domain.
includeAds.title: Include Ads

includeBlocks.description: Include knowledge graph, AI answer, inline images, inline videos, products, local companies and weather when present.
includeBlocks.title: Include SERP Blocks

includeRelatedSearches.description: Include the related-search suggestions shown below the results (requires Include SERP Blocks).
includeRelatedSearches.title: Include Related Searches

language.description: Yandex interface and search language. Match it to your query language to keep result text untranslated.
language.title: Language

maxItems.description: Global cap on unique items across all queries and pages (1-10,000). In rows mode this is the row count; in pages mode it caps the items inside page records.
maxItems.title: Max Items

maxPages.description: Number of result pages to read per query (1-25). Yandex serves at most 25 pages.
maxPages.title: Max Pages Per Query

mode.description: Search by keyword or parse existing Yandex SERP URLs.
mode.title: Mode

outputFormat.description: Page records preserve the existing dataset shape; rows emit one flat record per result or block item.
outputFormat.title: Output Format

queries.description: One or more search queries (mode=search). Each query is processed separately.
queries.title: Search Queries

region.description: Named Yandex region preset. Leave empty to use Yandex's default region. regionId overrides this value.
region.title: Region

regionId.description: Numeric Yandex region ID (lr). Overrides the Region preset. For example 213 is Moscow and 983 is Turkey.
regionId.title: Region ID

serpUrls.description: Yandex search-result URLs, one per page (mode=byUrls). Direct Yandex URLs and translated Yandex URLs are accepted.
serpUrls.title: Yandex SERP URLs

startPage.description: Zero-based page to start from (0-24). Use it to resume a deep result window.
startPage.title: Start Page

timeFilter.description: Limit results by recency. The values map to Yandex's own past-day, past-two-weeks and past-month filters.
timeFilter.title: Time Filter

title: Yandex SERP & Knowledge Graph Scraper Input
